cards.name: Opacity Pulse On Beat
cards.match: ADBE DE Opacity Pulse On Beat
cards.summary: Hidden pseudo effect: Min/Max Opacity, Attack, Decay and Audio Threshold sliders plus an audio-layer picker, meant to drive an opacity flash each time the music's amplitude crosses the threshold. It renders nothing by itself; an expression on Opacity must read it.
use_for: Flash a logo or hashtag on every bass hit in a reel
Beat-synced light-leak or glow layer in a trailer music bed
Pulse a 'BREAKING' tag in time with a news sting
avoid: Adding it alone and expecting motion: it is only a control panel, nothing moves until the expression is written
Busy music with a low threshold: flickers constantly and looks like a fault
Full-frame footage at Min 0: strobing footage is hard to watch and can be a photosensitivity risk

params.name: Min Opacity
params.does: Opacity (%) at the low point of each pulse
params.typical: 20-50 for a blink that never fully vanishes, 0 for a hard on/off

params.name: Max Opacity
params.does: Opacity (%) at the peak of each pulse

params.name: Attack
params.does: Rise speed of each pulse (inferred; our expression rises in 1/Attack seconds, so higher = snappier)
params.typical: 10-25 for a hard flash, 3-5 for a soft swell

params.name: Decay
params.does: Fall-off rate back to Min Opacity (our expression: exp(-Decay*t), higher = shorter tail)

params.name: Audio Keyframe Layer
params.does: Layer holding the converted audio amplitude keyframes

params.name: Audio Threshold
params.does: Amplitude level that counts as a beat
params.typical: 15-40; raise until only the kicks trigger

cards.scripting: Hidden pseudo effect (expression-control container defined in Support Files/PresetEffects.xml, verified 2026-10-03): it renders NOTHING by itself and no preset or script shipped with AE 2026 references it (grep of Support Files/Presets), so there is no 'matching preset' to apply. Add it with layer.property('ADBE Effect Parade').addProperty('ADBE DE Opacity Pulse On Beat'), set the sliders, then put an expression on Transform/Opacity that reads it. Adobe's original companion expression is not shipped, so use ours (untested, JavaScript expression engine; slider meanings are inferred from the names and defined by this expression): var c=effect("Opacity Pulse On Beat"),lo=c("Min Opacity"),hi=c("Max Opacity"),at=Math.max(c("Attack"),0.01),dc=c("Decay"),th=c("Audio Threshold");var s=c("Audio Keyframe Layer").effect("Both Channels")("Slider"),fd=thisComp.frameDuration,t0=-1;for(var i=0;i<150;i++){var tt=time-i*fd;if(tt<0)break;if(s.valueAtTime(tt)>=th&&s.valueAtTime(tt-fd)<th){t0=tt;break;}}var k=0;if(t0>=0){var t=time-t0,r=1/at;k=t<r?t/r:Math.exp(-dc*(t-r));}lo+(hi-lo)*k 'Audio Keyframe Layer' is a layer param: the props spec cannot set it; in ExtendScript use fx.property('Audio Keyframe Layer').setValue(audioLayer.index). cards.name: Opacity Pulse Random
cards.summary: Hidden pseudo effect: Min/Max Opacity, Attack, Decay and Min/Max Delay sliders, meant to drive opacity flashes at random intervals (an irregular flicker). It renders nothing by itself; an expression on Opacity must read it.
use_for: Broken neon / tube-light flicker on a title in a satire reel
Random flicker on a 'REC' or 'LIVE' badge
Unstable-signal feel on a CCTV or archive overlay

cards.name: Orbit
cards.summary: Hidden pseudo effect: Radius, Frequency and Starting Phase controls plus a 'Layer To Orbit' picker, meant to move a layer in a flat circle around another layer. It renders nothing by itself; an expression on Position must read it.
use_for: Icons or party symbols circling a central portrait in an explainer
A small 'NEW' badge orbiting a product or app logo
Looping orbiting dots for a loader or transition card
avoid: Adding it alone and expecting motion: it is only a control panel, nothing moves until the expression is written
Large radius on a 1080x1920 reel: the layer leaves the frame
Many orbiting items with the same phase: they stack on top of each other

params.does: Distance from the centre layer's anchor point in pixels

params.name: Frequency
params.does: Revolutions per second (our expression); negative reverses direction

params.name: Starting Phase
params.does: Angle control: start angle on the circle in degrees

params.name: Layer To Orbit
params.does: Layer used as the centre of the orbit

cards.name: Orbit 3D
cards.summary: Hidden pseudo effect: Radius, Frequency, Starting Phase, X/Z Tilt and Elevation controls plus a 'Layer To Orbit' picker, meant to move a 3D layer around another layer on a tilted ring so it passes in front of and behind it. It renders nothing by itself; an expression on Position must read it.
use_for: Logos or data tags orbiting a globe in a geopolitics explainer
Planet-ring style orbit of icons around a leader cut-out
Trailer title card with elements circling in depth
avoid: Adding it alone and expecting motion: it is only a control panel, nothing moves until the expression is written
2D layer or no camera: the depth is lost and it reads as a flat side-to-side slide
Large Elevation or Radius in a 1080x1920 reel: the layer leaves the frame

params.does: Distance from the centre layer in pixels

params.name: Frequency
params.does: Revolutions per second (our expression); negative reverses

params.name: Starting Phase
params.does: Angle control: start angle on the ring in degrees

params.name: Layer To Orbit
params.does: Layer used as the orbit centre

params.name: Z Tilt
params.does: Angle control: slants the ring around the Z axis (degrees)

params.name: X Tilt
params.does: Angle control: tips the ring toward the camera (our expression: 0 = flat horizontal ring seen edge-on)
params.typical: 15-30 to read as an ellipse seen from slightly above

params.name: Elevation
params.does: Raises the ring above the centre layer in pixels (our expression: positive = up)

cards.name: Oscillate
cards.summary: Hidden pseudo effect: Amplitude, Frequency, Decay, Direction, Delay and Cycle Time controls, meant to drive a damped back-and-forth shake along one axis, optionally repeating. It renders nothing by itself; an expression on Position must read it.
use_for: Spring-in wobble when a lower third or price tag lands
Repeating attention nudge on a 'Swipe up' or subscribe button
Small horizontal 'no' shake on a FALSE / FAKE stamp in a fact-check
avoid: Adding it alone and expecting motion: it is only a control panel, nothing moves until the expression is written
Large amplitude on text: unreadable while moving
Using it as camera shake on full-frame footage: exposes the frame edge, scale up first

params.name: Amplitude
params.does: Peak offset of the shake in pixels (inferred; negative flips the first swing)
params.typical: 15-40 for a punch hit, 60-150 for a big wobble

params.name: Frequency
params.does: Oscillations per second

params.name: Decay
params.does: Damping rate (our expression: exp(-Decay*t)); higher = settles faster

params.name: Direction
params.does: Angle control: axis of the shake in degrees (our expression: 0 = horizontal, 90 = vertical)

params.name: Delay
params.does: Wait after the layer's in point before the shake starts (seconds in our expression)

params.name: Cycle Time
params.does: Restart the shake every N seconds; 0 = once (our expression)

Add it with layer.property('ADBE Effect Parade').addProperty('ADBE DE Pendulum At Marker'), set the sliders, then put an expression on Transform/Rotation that reads it. Adobe's original companion expression is not shipped, so use ours (untested, JavaScript expression engine; slider meanings are inferred from the names and defined by this expression): var c=effect("Pendulum At Marker"),o=0;if(marker.numKeys>0){var n=marker.nearestKey(time).index;if(marker.key(n).time>time)n--;if(n>0){var t=time-marker.key(n).time;o=c("Amplitude")*Math.sin(2*Math.PI*c("Frequency")*t)*Math.exp(-c("Decay")*t);}}value+o Add layer markers at the hit points: layer.property('Marker').setValueAtTime(t, new MarkerValue('')). Set Anchor Point to the hinge first. No Premiere equivalent: keyframe the property there.

cards.name: Pendulum On Beat
cards.summary: Hidden pseudo effect: Amplitude, Frequency, Decay and Audio Threshold controls plus an audio-layer picker, meant to kick a layer into a damped pendulum swing whenever the music's amplitude crosses the threshold. It renders nothing by itself; an expression on Rotation must read it.
use_for: Swing a hanging logo or tag on bass hits in a reel
Beat-synced swing of a meme sticker
avoid: Adding it alone and expecting motion: it is only a control panel, nothing moves until the expression is written
Low threshold on busy music: the layer never settles

params.name: Amplitude
params.does: Peak swing in degrees added to Rotation around the anchor point (inferred)
params.typical: 10-25 for a hanging sign, 45 for a big swing

params.name: Frequency
params.does: Swings per second

params.name: Decay
params.does: Damping rate (our expression: exp(-Decay*t)); higher = comes to rest sooner

params.name: Audio Keyframe Layer
params.does: Layer with converted audio amplitude keyframes

params.name: Audio Threshold
params.does: Amplitude level that counts as a beat

cards.scripting: Hidden pseudo effect (expression-control container defined in Support Files/PresetEffects.xml, verified 2026-10-03): it renders NOTHING by itself and no preset or script shipped with AE 2026 references it (grep of Support Files/Presets), so there is no 'matching preset' to apply. Add it with layer.property('ADBE Effect Parade').addProperty('ADBE DE Pendulum On Beat'), set the sliders, then put an expression on Transform/Rotation that reads it. Adobe's original companion expression is not shipped, so use ours (untested, JavaScript expression engine; slider meanings are inferred from the names and defined by this expression): var c=effect("Pendulum On Beat"),th=c("Audio Threshold"),s=c("Audio Keyframe Layer").effect("Both Channels")("Slider"),fd=thisComp.frameDuration,t0=-1;for(var i=0;i<150;i++){var tt=time-i*fd;if(tt<0)break;if(s.valueAtTime(tt)>=th&&s.valueAtTime(tt-fd)<th){t0=tt;break;}}var t=time-t0;t0<0?value:value+c("Amplitude")*Math.sin(2*Math.PI*c("Frequency")*t)*Math.exp(-c("Decay")*t) 'Audio Keyframe Layer' is a layer param: the props spec cannot set it; in ExtendScript use fx.property('Audio Keyframe Layer').setValue(audioLayer.index). The audio layer must be the 'Audio Amplitude' layer made by Animation > Keyframe Assistant > Convert Audio to Keyframes (its 'Both Channels' Slider is what the expression reads). Set Anchor Point to the hinge first. No Premiere equivalent: keyframe the property there.
